decision.reason: [ev-689bc0108c6c] is one sentence that bundles eight subjects (the ForwardAuth middleware plus the HTTP, Consul, Etcd, Redis, ZooKeeper, Consul Catalog and Docker providers) and says only that `tls.caOptional` was removed. It does not say what happens to a configuration that still sets the option: rejection, an error, or the option being silently ignored. The deterministic CRD check contradicts the main reading: it found traefik.io Middleware spec.forwardAuth.tls.caOptional still present in the v3.0.0 schema [ev-0842f8f3bd9d]. So the evidence does not establish whether the removal applies to the CRD field, to provider/label configuration only, or to runtime handling. A writer needs per-subject evidence (provider option docs or code, or the actual v3 handling of the field) and a stated consequence before the assertion can be written.
